nodes.blurb: Shamanic and plant-medicine healing traditions of the Americas, entered only where lineage, teachers and screening are verifiable.
nodes.label: Shamanic traditions

nodes.blurb: Syncretic Amazonian religion founded by Raimundo Irineu Serra (1930s): Christianity, South American shamanism, African animism, Kardecist spiritism. Legal churches in Oregon, Los Angeles, Washington.
nodes.label: Santo Daime

nodes.blurb: Christian Spiritist religion founded by José Gabriel da Costa; hoasca sacrament; US Supreme Court exemption 2006 (Gonzales v. O Centro). Núcleos across the US.
nodes.label: União do Vegetal (UDV)

nodes.blurb: Shipibo-Conibo plant-spirit healing (curanderismo): onanya healers, ikaros songs, dietas. Entered via its longest-running centre, not via individual claims.
nodes.label: Shipibo curanderismo
